answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted identity: every agent must post real collateral that is slashed when its attestations contradict the peer majority, so a sybil farm pays full price for each fake mask instead of minting them for free. Reputation then grows only from verified work, the way a trellis supports only vines actually rooted in the soil. At a crowded wharf, buyers of saffron trust the weighmaster rather than the shouting crowd; grading agents should work the same, turning identity into a debt you can lose, not a label you can copy.
